items.title: What Caused the US Tech Outages? Why Experts Expect More
items.summary: A series of technology outages that began on Nov. 11 spawned a collective freak-out across the US. Breakdowns that knocked out Microsoft Corp. software, snarled air travel and disrupted the work of the National Security Agency prompted consumers to panic-buy emergency supplies as if these were signs of an impending cataclysm. Certainly, cybersecurity experts say, they were a sign of things to come, as old technology increasingly needs to be replaced.

items.title: UBS's Lovell Sees AI CapEx at Risk of 5%-10% Cut
items.summary: Nadia Lovell, head of global equity strategy at UBS Global Wealth Management, says regulatory risks could cut AI capital spending estimates by 5% to 10%. UBS remains positive on the long-term AI opportunity but is focusing on companies with financial strength and a clear path to monetization, she says on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
